body:
Triage (objectstack-wide triage seat): routed to the decision inbox — `needs-user-decision`. The defect half is real and measured (the selection bar honours `userActions.delete` only as a boolean while the row kebab honours the predicate), but the remedy requires a product-semantics ruling: what a per-record `visibleWhen` means over a SET has three defensible answers (the card's options 1–3), and the choice fixes the published meaning of a declared key across surfaces — maintainer floor, not PM-delegable.

Four-prong card face:
- **Platform long-term coherence** — any ruling ends the current state where the same declared key silently means different things on two surfaces; Option 3 chosen *without* the accompanying spec-text note would entrench it.
- **Measured business pull** — measured on showcase `showcase_invoice` (a paid invoice is offered Delete from the bar). UI-only leak; server enforcement intact; found in dogfood, no customer report.
- **AI-agent error-resistance** — Option 1 (run over the allowed subset and report the skipped rows via the existing `bulk-skipped-notice` slot) keeps the declaration enforced and loud; today's silent divergence is the failure mode agents copy.
- **Startup scope discipline** — Option 2 (gate the button while any excluded row is selected) is the cheapest coherent gate; Option 1 moderate (the dialog slot already exists); Option 3 is docs-only but a permanent caveat.

Recommendation: **Option 1** if the `BulkActionDialog` slot fits as built (keeps the predicate meaningful on mixed selections); Option 2 acceptable as the minimal coherent gate. Related: objectui#4419 (detail-header half, plain defect), objectui#4296 (row kebab ignores the record-level verdict).

本评论来自分诊座位 Routine。

_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

**Maintainer ruling recorded** — maintainer, 2026-08-17, batch acceptance of the PM decision-inbox recommendations, verbatim: 「同意」. Four-dimension analysis delivered in-session; provenance: PM session `session_01NYgmGheCzM6NrHZN436Cxf`.

**Ruled: behaviour 1 — filter the operation and report the skipped.** The selection-bar Delete evaluates `userActions.delete.visibleWhen` per selected record, runs over the allowed subset, and reports the excluded rows through `BulkActionDialog`'s existing `bulk-skipped-notice` slot (built for exactly this shape). Behaviour 2 rejected (one stray tick disabling the whole bar punishes mixed selections); behaviour 3 rejected (the key must not mean different things on two surfaces).

Edge decided with it: a selection where **every** row is excluded shows the button leading to the dialog reporting zero eligible rows — a legible refusal, not a hidden button whose absence is unexplained. Grid-path (`ObjectGrid`'s own bar) follows the same rule. Applies to the built-in Delete; declared bulk actions with their own predicates inherit the same evaluation shape.

Label `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue` in the same stroke.

**Claim:** PM session `session_011SfZeFWrhGLHmfq61xbz4q` (`domain:ui` execution seat) — branch `claude/issue-4420-bulk-delete-visiblewhen`. `pm:queue` → `pm:dispatched` in the same label write.

## Pre-dispatch gate (three steps, all run — readings below)

**1. Thread read.** Both comments read in full. **A maintainer ruling is on this card** (os-zhuang, 2026-08-17T22:39:14Z), maintainer's word quoted verbatim there as 「同意」. It is binding and it is reproduced in full below. ⛔ Do not re-open the three-option question — it is decided.

**2. Shadow check.** Three devs in flight. `#5853` holds `packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` — **a file you also need**. See the serial clause below; it is a hard precondition, not advice. `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` and `packages/plugin-grid/src/components/BulkActionDialog.tsx` are held by nobody.

**3. Call-site census** (`origin/main`) — the seam already exists, do not build a second one:
```
packages/plugin-grid/src/rowCrudAffordances.ts:105   resolveRowCrudAffordances(...)  →  { canDelete, objectCanDelete, deletePredicates }
packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx:900          already destructures `deletePredicates`
packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx:1172-1176      permittedBulkActions — the defect site; reads `.delete` as a BOOLEAN only
packages/core                                        evalRowPredicate(...)  — the non-hook evaluator
packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx:1172  useRowPredicate(...)  — the HOOK form
```

⭐ **The single most expensive mistake available on this card:** reaching for `useRowPredicate`. A bulk gate evaluates **N selected records in a loop**, and React forbids calling a hook per iteration. Use **`evalRowPredicate` from `@object-ui/core`** — the same primitive `RelatedRecordActionsBridge.tsx:82` imports for exactly this reason. The per-record predicate you feed it is `deletePredicates.visibleWhen`, already produced by `resolveRowCrudAffordances`.

## Maintainer ruling — reproduced verbatim, implement exactly this

> **Ruled: behaviour 1 — filter the operation and report the skipped.** The selection-bar Delete evaluates `userActions.delete.visibleWhen` per selected record, runs over the allowed subset, and reports the excluded rows through `BulkActionDialog`'s existing `bulk-skipped-notice` slot (built for exactly this shape). Behaviour 2 rejected (one stray tick disabling the whole bar punishes mixed selections); behaviour 3 rejected (the key must not mean different things on two surfaces).
>
> Edge decided with it: a selection where **every** row is excluded shows the button leading to the dialog reporting zero eligible rows — a legible refusal, not a hidden button whose absence is unexplained. Grid-path (`ObjectGrid`'s own bar) follows the same rule. Applies to the built-in Delete; declared bulk actions with their own predicates inherit the same evaluation shape.

Three consequences worth restating because each is a way to get this wrong:
- The button is **never hidden or disabled** by the predicate. Filtering happens at execution, reporting happens in the dialog.
- **Zero eligible rows still opens the dialog** and says so. An empty selection result is a message, not a no-op.
- The grid path gets the **same** rule, not a similar one.

## ⛔ Serial clause — `packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` is in flight

`#5853` currently holds that file (unpushed, 1 commit) at the **column-type emit seam** — its only hunks are at `:26` (an import) and `:2248` (+29 lines). Your face there is the **bulk-action bar** (`:2645-2690`, `:3782-3850`) and the `deletePredicates` already destructured at `:900`. Disjoint regions, but the same file and no PR yet.

Work in this order:
1. **`packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` + `BulkActionDialog` first.** No collision; land the semantics and the tests there.
2. **Before your first edit to `ObjectGrid.tsx`:** `git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main`. If `#5853` has landed by then you are merging its hunks in cleanly. If it has not, proceed anyway — the regions are disjoint — but say so in the PR body so the second-lander knows to re-fetch.
3. ⛔ Do not rewrite, reformat, or "tidy" anything in `ObjectGrid.tsx` outside your own region. A whitespace pass on that file will collide with `#5853` even though the logic does not.

## Boundaries

- This is a **UI affordance**, and the triage record measured it as such: *"UI-only leak; server enforcement intact."* You are not touching a security boundary — the server still refuses. ⛔ Do not widen this into a permissions change.
- `#4419` (detail-header half) and `#4296` (row kebab ANDs only the object-level permission) are **separate cards**. Out of scope. If your reading turns up evidence about either, file it as a comment there — do not fix it here.
- ⛔ Do not change what `visibleWhen` means anywhere else, and do not touch `packages/spec`. If you conclude the spec text needs a note, say so in the report and the PM routes it to the `domain:spec` seat.

## Tests

- Cover all three selections: **all-eligible**, **mixed**, **none-eligible**. The mixed case must assert both halves — the allowed subset was deleted *and* the skipped rows were reported through `bulk-skipped-notice`.
- ⛔ Ghost-assertion guard: run each new assertion against unmodified `origin/main` and show it **failing** first. The repro in the card body (`showcase_invoice`, `delete: { visibleWhen: P\`record.status != 'paid'\` }`, tick only paid `INV-1011`) is the shape to encode.
- ⛔ Degenerate-control guard: a test whose fixture has no excluded rows passes against the current broken code. State in the PR body which fixture row is the excluded one.

## Ground rules

Worktree-first (`git worktree add ../objectui-4420 -b claude/issue-4420-bulk-delete-visiblewhen main`). ⛔ Never `git stash` — the stack lives in the common `.git` dir and is shared across every worktree of this repo; a `pop` silently takes another agent's work and reports success. ⛔ Never touch `content/docs/releases/` in a code PR. Changeset: `patch`, for each package you actually change. Open the PR as **draft** and report back — the PM lands it, ⛔ never self-merge.

Size: M. Model: opus.
